bias.zh: 上升趋势暂歇 · 守住 $258，受制于 $264–265

read.en: Amazon slipped 0.3% on Nov 6 to $259.30, trading $258.53–264.18. It holds above all its averages: the rising 5-day ($256.4), 30-day ($253.7), 100-day ($252.5) and 200-day ($243.9) and the falling 10-day ($252.3). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 4, above zero, with the histogram still rising; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($231.92), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月6日微跌 0.3%，收于 $259.30，盘中区间 $258.53–264.18。股价位于所有均线上方：上行的 5 日（$256.4）、30 日（$253.7）、100 日（$252.5）和 200 日均线（$243.9），以及下行的 10 日均线（$252.3）。MACD 于 11月4日上穿信号线，位于零轴上方，柱状图仍在上升；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$231.92），RSI 为 54。

read.en: No level changed: the $257–259.5 support held at the $258.53 low, and the $264.18 high stopped under the $263.9–265.3 resistance. Resistance is $263.9–265.3 (Nov 4 low, Oct 20 high), then $271.5–273.2 (Nov 4–5 highs) and $287.2. Support is $257–259.5, then $252.3–253.7 (10, 30 and 100-day) and $243.9 (200-day). A close above $265.3 would target $271.5–273; below $257, $252–254.
